command:
source "$HOME/build-workers/worker-env.sh" || exit $?
pnpm fixtures || exit $?
git diff --exit-code 475c5edca5ab4c8ba99a92874504240b2fecffe3 HEAD -- native/smlib-adapter || exit $?
export IFCLITE_SMLIB_WORKER="/home/louistrue/build-workers/worker-state/caches/1c8ef91bc19f507e5b98a277/ifclite-smlib/native-475c5edca5ab4c8ba99a92874504240b2fecffe3-b6f0d1ab2604/ifclite_smlib_worker"
printf '69851c21038602964acdabc9a22ac02a4421b9682bef4f6d3714e4ff02976e23  %s\n' "$IFCLITE_SMLIB_WORKER" | sha256sum -c - || exit $?
printf 'Native executable source475c, source inputs unchanged; native lineage CTests remain failed. SDK-gated Rust tests enabled.\n'
cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast
workspace_status=$?
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
clippy_status=$?
printf 'workspace_exit=%s clippy_exit=%s\n' "$workspace_status" "$clippy_status"
if [ "$workspace_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$workspace_status"; fi
exit "$clippy_status"
